description: Given/expected scenarios translated from the upload worker and job store tests. Common setup unless stated: now = 2026-08-05T08:00:00Z; one profile; account connected at now-2h with automatic upload enabled (watermark now-2h); one completed Hardware session started at now-1h, 60 s long, 0.1 km, one sample with HR 130 (max 140). A fake Garmin client records calls as 'search', 'download', 'upload', 'delete'. Worker steps are driven by: lease next job at a given time, process it.

workerOutcomeMapping.clientUploadResult: ambiguous (no/invalid response line, process crashed after send)
client unavailable (feature flag off / runtime missing)

invariantsForAll: the uploaded file was a readable FIT (> 16 bytes)
no job is leasable one hour later (no automatic retry of any of these outcomes)

scenarios.name: PreferWatch strong match records FoundInGarmin and uploads nothing
PreferWatch strong match without local heart rate still matches by shape
MergeAndReplace with a distinct replacement ID runs the full merge

given.afterDeleteSearchReturns: replacement-456 plus a watch-recreated copy 'watch-resynced' whose FIT equals the backed-up original

No-ID replacement never uploads again; exhausted checks become Unknown; Merge into one resumes read-only

steps.result: after the third check: Unknown/ResolveReplacement, MatchedRemoteId watch-123, ReplacementRemoteId null

Multiple plausible watch activities require review without uploading a third copy
Undo merge restores exactly one watch original and one plain local source, and Merge into one can follow

Confirmed, RemoteId = ReplacementRemoteId = corrected-3, MatchedRemoteId restored-original

storeScenarios.name: completed session is queued once; an Unknown outcome is never retried
steps: reconcile twice => one job
lease => AttemptCount 1
mark mutation phase Upload
at now+3m (lease expired) nothing leasable; job is Unknown
at now+1h nothing leasable
Retry known failure => refused
status Unknown count 1
Dismiss => allowed; Unknown count 0

storeScenarios.name: enable watermark skips old history; atomic lease has one winner
steps: connect+enable at now: session ended before now => 0 jobs
disconnect, reconnect at now+1m => still 0 jobs
session moved to start now+1m, end now+2m => reconcile at now+3m queues it
two workers lease concurrently at now+8m => exactly one gets it

storeScenarios.name: stale read lease cannot cross the mutation boundary
steps: worker A leases at now (expires now+2m)
at now+3m worker B leases the same job (A's read lease expired => Pending again)
A tries to mark ReplacementUpload with its old lease => rejected
B marks ReplacementUpload => persisted with B's evidence

storeScenarios.name: stale replacement resolution cannot overwrite a newer phase
steps: A leases at now; B leases at now+3m and marks ReplacementUpload (watch-current)
A tries to mark replacement resolved with its old lease => rejected
job stays InFlight/ReplacementUpload, MatchedRemoteId watch-current, ReplacementRemoteId null

storeScenarios.name: accounts and watch bindings are isolated per profile
steps: Marc connected (disabled), Partner not connected
watch bindings per profile resolved by token hash
enabling Marc with MergeAndReplace does not touch Partner

storeScenarios.name: disconnect is rejected while a job is in flight
steps: lease a job
disconnect => error containing 'cannot be cancelled'; account kept
mark Unknown
disconnect with current version => account and its jobs deleted

storeScenarios.name: Unknown can be acknowledged as found
steps: mark Unknown
acknowledge found => FoundInGarmin, AcknowledgedAt set, RemoteId null, CanRetry false
not leasable; Retry refused

storeScenarios.name: Unknown plain upload verified absent can be requeued idempotently
steps: MergeAndReplace; lease; mark Upload; mark Unknown
confirm absent (operation X) at now+6m => Pending/WatchSearch, AttemptCount 0, leasable
same operation X again => replay error (no second requeue)

storeScenarios.name: Unknown replacement upload cannot be retried as verified absent
steps: mark ReplacementUpload then uncertain => Unknown/ReplacementUpload with MatchedRemoteId
confirm absent => rejected
job unchanged; not leasable

storeScenarios.name: expired replacement-upload lease resumes read-only
steps: mark ReplacementUpload (watch-original)
at now+3m the lease expired => Unknown/ReplacementUpload
listed as incomplete replacement
resume => Pending/ResolveReplacement with MatchedRemoteId watch-original

storeScenarios.name: verified resync completes terminally
steps: ReplacementUpload -> replacement uploaded (replacement-1) => Pending/DeleteOriginal
lease => DeleteOriginal; original deleted => Pending/VerifyResync
lease => VerifyResync; complete => Confirmed/Upload, RemoteId replacement-1, AttemptCount 0, CanRetry false, RetryAt null, never leasable again

storeScenarios.name: duplicate can be retried from watch search
steps: MergeAndReplace; mark Upload; mark rejected duplicate => CanRetry
retry => leased at now+1m in phase WatchSearch with AttemptCount 1

storeScenarios.name: failed watch-FIT merge can be retried before any remote mutation
steps: lease in WatchSearch; mark rejected merge-source => CanRetry, MatchedRemoteId null
retry => leased in WatchSearch

storeScenarios.name: historical recovery preserves durable identities
steps: job Unknown/DeleteOriginal with Matched watch-original, Replacement merged-1: Merge into one => ResolveReplacement keeping both IDs
job Confirmed/UndoComplete with Matched restored-watch, RemoteId local-1: Undo merge => keeps restored-watch and local-1 (DeleteGeneratedCopies)

storeScenarios.name: legacy Confirmed job can be requeued only for MergeAndReplace
steps: Confirmed, phase WatchSearch, no IDs, account MergeAndReplace => Re-run merge check => Pending/WatchSearch
same with PreferWatch => rejected

connectionScenarios.name: MFA is profile-bound and tokens are protected at rest
steps: begin connect for Marc => MfaRequired + challengeId
complete that challenge as Partner => not found; Marc still not connected
begin again for Marc (enabled, MergeAndReplace), complete with code => Connected, enabled, MergeAndReplace
stored token blob does not contain the plaintext token; decrypting yields it
the password was only handed to the login process

connectionScenarios.name: pending MFA is replaced per profile and globally bounded
steps: begin for profile P twice => the first pending login is disposed
3 more profiles begin => 4 pending
a 5th profile => error containing 'too many'
